[message_id=683394 author=lucian kucera first=True]
Lets say I train model on reasoning traces of much larger model, is that allowed?
IF we can distill larger models, can we get rough list which models are allowed?
For example someone generates 100k of reasoning traces using claude opus 4.6, since they don't have obfuscated reasoning traces. Than does SFT on those traces, would have imense advantage. Maybe even disilling nvidia/Nemotron-4-340B-Instruct or some other ultra large opensource model like kimi/deepseek.

[message_id=3426058 author=CPMP first=False]
Your submission must be a LORA adapter to Nemotron v3 Nano. The way you train this LORA adapter is open.

[message_id=3428508 author=guoqin gu first=False]
Hi @cpmpml ! Does this mean we are allowed to use responses generated by closed-source flagship models to train our own models?

[message_id=3428535 author=CPMP first=False]
This depends on the license for the output of these models. Some models let you reuse their output freely, some don't. Check the license of what you use.

[message_id=3426022 author=Barno Barno first=False]
isn't distilling anthropic models against their TOS? though I'm not sure if publicly available ones counts as violation.

[message_id=3425368 author= first=False]


[message_id=3425383 author=lucian kucera first=False]
Internet connection doesn't prevent u from distilling.
